title: Orange Thai Chicken
description: The Thai Chicken's sibling — same ginger and chilli base but brightened with fresh orange juice for a citrus-forward cream sauce.

method.instruction: Melt half the butter in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Pan-fry chicken breast for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and rest on a warm plate.
In the same pan, add remaining butter. Add diced onion and grated ginger and cook until softened and fragrant, about 2–3 minutes.
Add fresh chili and cook briefly for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Deglaze the pan with fresh orange juice. Let it reduce by half, about 1–2 minutes.
Pour in thickened cream and reduce for 2–3 minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon. Season with salt.
Stir in orange zest just before serving. Plate the chicken and spoon the citrus-cream sauce generously over the top.

notes.title: Orange Forward
notes.content: The orange juice and zest lead this sauce — it should be distinctly citrus-forward with the cream providing body and richness rather than dominating. The ginger and chilli add warmth without overpowering the orange. No demi glace is used.
